show.title: The Boys
show.synopsis: A fun and irreverent take on what happens when superheroes—who are as popular as celebrities and influential as politicians—abuse their superpowers rather than use them for good.

statusTimeline.note: Former SAS operative bent on taking down Vought and Homelander; recruits Hughie Campbell.
Discovers his wife Becca is alive raising Homelander's biological son.
Traumatized after speedster superhero A-Train runs through his girlfriend Robin on the sidewalk.

typeTimeline.note: Butcher harnesses Hughie's grief to infiltrate Vought International.

recaps.title: The Name of the Game
recaps.safeSummary: AV electronics clerk Hughie Campbell's life is shattered when Vought superhero A-Train runs straight through his girlfriend Robin at supersonic speed. Disillusioned by Vought's hollow corporate apologies and non-disclosure settlements, Hughie is approached by Billy Butcher, an operative seeking revenge on reckless 'Supes'. Meanwhile, idealistic small-town hero Annie January (Starlight) joins The Seven, quickly discovering the dark, exploitative reality behind the hero facade.
bullets: A-Train obliterates Hughie's girlfriend Robin in broad daylight with zero repercussions.
Billy Butcher recruits Hughie by revealing that superheroes are privately corrupt and reckless.
Annie January (Starlight) passes the audition for The Seven but is immediately coerced by The Deep.
Hughie plants a listening device inside The Seven's boardroom at Vought Tower.
Translucent tracks Hughie down; Butcher intervenes and they electrocute and capture him.
majorEvents: Robin's tragic death on the street
Formation of The Boys alliance between Hughie and Butcher
unresolvedQuestions: Why was A-Train moving so fast and what blue substance was he injecting?
What really happened to Butcher's wife Becca?
recaps.cliffhanger: Butcher and Hughie stand over the unconscious, diamond-skinned body of Translucent in Hughie's electronics shop.
